defect: the destination clear output bypasses the synchronized clear state
rationale: a_clear_i is asynchronous to clk_b and b_clear_o is driven directly from it even though a two-stage synchronized clear state is present for the destination controller.
author: gpt-5.6-luna

labels.by: claude-sonnet (blind second labeller, design and constraints only)
labels.note: b_clear_o is driven directly from the clk_a-domain a_clear_i, bypassing the synchroniser.

provenance.adaptation: Kept the two-clock clear/isolation controller context and destination clear synchronizer, reduced the phase machine and acknowledgement protocol, and exposed a self-contained top module.

mutation.description: Drove b_clear_o directly from a_clear_i instead of the synchronized clear_s1_b state.
